validation.scope: 69 source tests passed. Browser checks verify 15px chapter labels and 20px desktop Module titles, the expanded Module 2 directory at 1440px and 1024px widths, nested chapter navigation with active selection, narrow desktop and mobile layouts without page overflow, and shared reading surfaces across Project, Wet Lab, Dry Lab and Human Practices.
